procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：胡佛壩
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Hoover Dam
guides.concept: 以胡佛壩為背景，區分自重抗滑與拱向傳力、裂縫連通與揚壓，以及冷卻收縮與接縫閉合。後半部把壓力瞬變、低水頭出力、排砂與量測溫漂連結，讓學員用相互獨立的證據判斷異常原因。所有試算都明示幾何與材料是假想值，不替代既有壩評估。
guides.conceptEn: Using Hoover as context, distinguish gravity resistance from arch transfer, crack connectivity from uplift, and cooling contraction from joint closure. Later units connect pressure transients, low-head output, sediment and measurement drift, requiring independent evidence to distinguish causes. Every calculation uses declared hypothetical geometry or material data and cannot replace assessment of the existing dam.
procedure: 拱重力壩把一部分水平荷載沿拱圈送到兩岸，也把一部分荷載透過壩底傳入基礎。教材以同位移的平行彈簧理解剛度與分力，不把它當成真實拱壩公式。岩體節理、施工縫及溫度會改變相容條件，所以增加某路徑剛度也會改變其他路徑分擔。 平行彈簧共同位移來自相容條件，若兩岸支承本身移動，需把支承位移加入，分力比例就不再只由剛度決定。
基礎裂縫是否與上游水連通，會改變揚壓分布而不只是減少受壓面積。教材把已假設的壓力分布積分成向上合力，再討論裂縫開口與排水能力對分布的影響。裂縫長度不能獨立決定壓力，因流動阻力、下游水位與排水孔都參與控制。 排水點可能讓壓力圖出現折線，積分時應按各段面積相加，作用點也必須用各段力矩求得。
大體積混凝土降溫同時涉及熱量移除與空間溫差，兩者不可互相代替。比熱模型能估算均勻降溫所需移除的顯熱，但表面冷得過快可能提高內外約束應力。需把水化熱產生、冷卻水帶走熱量與周邊散熱分列，才能判斷熱量帳是否閉合。 熱擴散時間隨特徵長度平方變化，縮小試件的冷卻曲線不能直接按時間等比例搬到大體積壩塊。
分塊澆置留下的接縫，其開合取決於塊體自由熱變形、相鄰約束與水壓。線膨脹模型只描述未受約束的長度變化，接縫灌漿後的應力則需用實際約束分析。不能把某溫度下的縫寬直接解讀為永久缺陷，也不能把所有縫寬變化都歸於氣溫。 接縫量測方向若與縫面法線不一致，需將位移投影分解，否則剪切位移也可能混入開合讀值。
導葉或閥門快速變動使水流動量轉為壓力波，波速同時受水的可壓縮性與管壁彈性影響。焦科夫斯基關係適合估計快速速度改變的首波幅度；反射、分岔與調壓設施會改變後續波形，因此單一首波不能取代整段管路的暫態包絡。 反射的符號取決於邊界阻抗，水庫端與封閉閥端可能產生不同反射，因此應在時空圖標明每個邊界。
高速溢洪流在不平整表面附近會產生局部低壓，是否形成汽穴要比較局部絕對壓力與水的蒸氣壓。汽蝕數把可用壓力差除以動壓，便於比較流況，但臨界值仍依表面幾何、含氣與尺度而異。以平均壓力計算只能作初步篩查。 蒸氣壓取決於水溫，而局部絕對壓也受大氣壓影響，兩者均應使用與事件同時的條件比較。
庫水位下降使可用水頭改變，維持同一功率可能需要增加流量，但管路損失和機組運轉範圍限制這種補償。教材先固定流量與效率比較水頭對出力的直接作用，再要求用機組特性曲線檢查效率假設，不能線性外推至所有低水位。 導葉開度與流量的關係隨水頭改變，固定開度不等於固定流量，比較模型時必須明確哪一項受到控制。
入庫流速降低使較粗顆粒優先沉降，三角洲前緣位置影響取水與通道幾何。簡化的體積除以橫截面積只能估算平均前移距離，不能描述底坡、粒徑分選及潛流。應把泥砂供給與可容納空間分開，避免把局部淤高等同全庫均勻填滿。 沉積前緣可能沿舊河槽形成狹長分支，使用全庫平均寬度會稀釋這種集中前移，需要保留局部地形。
垂線觀測相對位置時，量測支架與讀數裝置也會受到溫度影響。把已校準的儀器溫度係數乘溫差，可估算需扣除的儀器漂移，但不能順便移除壩體真正熱變形。兩種效應必須以獨立基準、內部溫度與不同原理位移儀共同辨識。 溫漂係數具有量測軸向與安裝條件，儀器移位或更換支架後須重新檢查，不能沿用舊校準而未記錄。
備援只有在失效機制足夠獨立時才能降低同時失效機率。兩部泵可能共用電源、進水池或控制器，因此把單機失效機率直接相乘會過度樂觀。教材先建立明示獨立的基準，再加入共同原因事件，強調可靠度數值取決於系統邊界與資料期間。 故障機率須附需求期間與成功功能定義，短時啟動成功與長時持續抽水成功是兩個不同的事件。
procedureEn: An arch-gravity dam transfers some horizontal load toward the abutments and some through its base. Parallel springs with equal displacement illustrate stiffness-controlled sharing, not a real arch-dam design equation. Rock joints, construction joints and temperature alter compatibility, so stiffening one path changes the load carried by the other path as well. Equal spring displacement follows compatibility; moving supports introduce imposed displacements, after which stiffness ratios alone no longer determine the force shares between the paths.

Whether a foundation crack connects to upstream water changes uplift distribution as well as contact area. Integrating an explicitly assumed pressure diagram gives the upward resultant; crack aperture and drainage then explain possible changes to that diagram. Crack length alone cannot determine pressure because flow resistance, tailwater and drains also control it. A drain may introduce a breakpoint in the pressure diagram; sum segment areas for force and segment moments for the resultant location on the base.

Cooling mass concrete involves both heat removal and spatial gradients, which are not interchangeable. Heat capacity estimates sensible energy for uniform cooling, while rapid surface cooling can increase restraint stresses. Separate hydration heat, heat carried by cooling water and environmental exchange to establish whether the thermal account actually closes. Thermal diffusion time scales with characteristic length squared, so cooling observations from small specimens cannot be transferred to massive blocks by simple linear time scaling.

A joint between concrete blocks opens or closes through thermal strain, neighboring restraint and water loading. Linear expansion describes free length change only; stress after grouting depends on actual restraint. Joint width at one temperature is not automatically a permanent defect, and not every width change can be attributed to air temperature. A gauge not aligned with the joint normal requires displacement projection; otherwise tangential movement can contaminate the apparent opening or closure of the joint.

Rapid guide-vane or valve movement converts flow momentum into a pressure wave whose speed depends on water compressibility and pipe elasticity. The Joukowsky relation estimates the first wave from a rapid velocity change. Reflections, branches and surge facilities alter later waves, so one first-wave estimate is not a full transient envelope. Reflection sign depends on boundary impedance; reservoir and closed-valve ends can reflect differently, so every boundary must be identified on the space-time diagram.

High-speed spillway flow can create local low pressure near surface irregularities. Vapor formation depends on absolute pressure relative to vapor pressure. A cavitation number normalizes available pressure by dynamic pressure, but its critical value depends on geometry, aeration and scale. A value based on mean pressure is therefore a preliminary indicator only. Vapor pressure depends on water temperature and absolute local pressure depends on atmospheric conditions; both should represent the same event rather than unrelated reference conditions.

Falling reservoir level changes available head, and maintaining power may require more discharge. Conveyance losses and the machine operating range limit that compensation. First hold flow and efficiency constant to isolate the direct head effect, then consult machine characteristics; the assumed efficiency cannot be extrapolated to every low-water condition. The relation between guide-vane opening and discharge changes with head; fixed opening is not fixed flow, so the controlled quantity must be stated explicitly.

Deceleration at reservoir entry deposits coarse material preferentially, and delta position affects intake and channel geometry. Deposited volume divided by a representative cross-sectional area estimates mean advance only; it omits bed slope, sorting and density currents. Sediment supply and accommodation space must be distinguished from uniform filling of the reservoir. A depositional front may advance as a narrow lobe along the old channel; reservoir-average width conceals that concentration and should not replace local geometry.

Pendulum observations include temperature effects in mounting and readout hardware as well as movement of the structure. A calibrated instrument coefficient estimates instrumental drift, but must not remove genuine thermal deformation of the dam. Independent reference control, internal temperature and another displacement principle are needed to separate the effects. A drift coefficient belongs to a measurement axis and mounting arrangement; relocation or replacement of the support requires renewed checks and documented calibration continuity.

Redundancy reduces simultaneous failure only when failure mechanisms are sufficiently independent. Two pumps may share power, a sump or controls, making a simple product of individual probabilities optimistic. Establish an explicitly independent baseline before adding a common-cause event, and define the system boundary and observation period for every probability. A probability needs a demand interval and a defined success function; successful starting and sustained pumping throughout a long event are different reliability questions.
evidence: 把拱座路徑剛度減半，重算兩種分力與共同位移，畫出每個路徑的自由體圖，列出需要岩體試驗才能確認的模型參數。
比較線性分布與上游半段保持高壓的分段分布，分別求合力及作用點，說明相同上游水位下為何抗滑與傾覆判斷都會改變。
對同一熱量設計均勻與偏側冷卻兩個假想溫度剖面，指出哪些測點能區分兩者，再估算多移除一開爾文顯熱所需的額外能量。
用三種熱膨脹係數重算自由伸長，另畫受約束與無約束兩個自由體圖，列出從位移轉成應力還缺少的剛度及接觸條件。
分別把速度變化減半及波速降低，計算首波幅度，再用示意時空圖標出反射路徑，寫明何時必須改用完整特徵線暫態模型。
evidenceEn: Halve the abutment-path stiffness and recalculate both load shares and common displacement. Draw a free-body diagram for each path and identify the parameters that require rock-mass testing before interpretation.

Compare the linear diagram with a piecewise diagram retaining high pressure over the upstream half. Find each resultant and its location, then explain changes in both sliding and overturning interpretation.

Construct uniform and one-sided cooling profiles with the same total heat removal. Identify sensors that distinguish them, then calculate the additional sensible energy associated with one more kelvin of cooling.

Recalculate free extension for three thermal expansion coefficients. Draw restrained and unrestrained free-body diagrams, then list stiffness and contact information still needed to convert displacement into a stress estimate.

Halve the velocity change and reduce wave speed in separate cases. Calculate first-wave amplitudes, mark reflection paths on a space-time diagram, and state when a full method-of-characteristics transient model is required.
pitfalls: 拱座節理張開會使承載路徑變軟並把荷載移向其他部位；若只校準壩頂單點位移，可能得到看似正確的總剛度，卻完全錯判局部應力集中。
冷卻太集中會造成局部溫度梯度及裂縫，即使平均溫度下降符合目標也可能出現問題；裂縫又改變水密與局部傳熱，因此不能只以總移熱量驗收冷卻品質。
延遲關閉或不協調的保護動作可能形成多次反射峰值，最大壓力不一定在首波；低壓端的液柱分離也可能在重新接合時產生更大衝擊。
為補償低水頭而增加流量，可能提高損失與不穩定流動，使預期增益落空；若流量計受流態改變影響，也會出現虛假的效率提升，需用獨立量測核對。
用壩體量測本身回歸儀器溫度係數，可能把真正結構反應吸收到校正項而掩蓋變化；固定端鬆動則可能造成非線性跳值，線性溫漂公式無法修復。
pitfallsEn: Opening abutment joints soften one load path and transfer force elsewhere. Calibrating only one crest displacement may reproduce overall stiffness while completely misrepresenting local stress concentrations and the distribution of support reactions.

Concentrated cooling can create local gradients and cracking even when average temperature meets its target. Cracks subsequently alter watertightness and heat transfer, so total extracted energy alone cannot establish the quality of the cooling process.

Delayed or uncoordinated protective actions can produce repeated reflected peaks, with the maximum occurring after the first wave. Column separation on the low-pressure side can generate a larger impact when the separated liquid columns rejoin.

Increasing flow to compensate for low head may raise losses and unstable-flow effects enough to defeat the expected gain. A meter affected by altered flow patterns can also indicate a false efficiency improvement, requiring independent verification.

Regressing instrument sensitivity from dam movement itself can absorb genuine structural behavior into a correction term and conceal changes. A loose mounting point can cause nonlinear jumps that a linear thermal-drift equation cannot repair.

courses.summary:
胡佛壩位於科羅拉多河黑峽谷，工程把河流導引、岩體支承與大體積混凝土整合在同一狹窄場址。1931年起的施工先要創造能施作壩基的條件；1933年開始的壩體混凝土作業，又把熱與收縮變成重要的工序問題。

1935年壩體混凝土完成，後續仍有機電與附屬工程。這段歷史適合用來理解：完工不是一個所有功能同時成立的瞬間。地圖採用美國墾務局公布的壩址座標；課程中的熱曲線、水路及檢核表是原創示意，並非真實壩體的操作或安全評估。
courses.summaryEn:
Hoover Dam occupies Black Canyon on the Colorado River, combining diversion, rock support and mass concrete at one constrained site. Construction beginning in 1931 first had to create workable foundation conditions. Dam-concrete placement beginning in 1933 made heat and contraction major sequence questions.

Dam-concrete placement finished in 1935, with power and associated works forming further parts of completion. This history shows why completion is not one instant when every function becomes established. The map uses Bureau of Reclamation dam coordinates; course thermal curves, water routes and review sheets are original teaching models, not operating instructions or a safety assessment.
courses.connection: 從黑峽谷追蹤水與力的兩種路徑，再用分塊、冷卻及接縫說明工序依賴。以監測和侵蝕案例練習把損傷現象與成因假說分開。
courses.connectionEn: Trace separate water and force paths through Black Canyon, then use blocks, cooling and joints to examine dependencies. Monitoring and erosion cases teach separation of observed damage from causal hypotheses.
